decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Application Form, Design and Access Statement, 1205-PL-001-P01, 1205-PL-002-P01, 1205-PL-003-P01, 1205-PL-004-P01, 1205-PL-005-P01, 1205-PL-006-P01, 1205-PL-009-P01, Received 15 June 2012, 1205-PL-007-P02, 1205-PL-008-P03, 1205-PL-010-P02, 1205-PL-011-P02, Received 2 August 2012, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Detailed drawings of all external rainwater, drainage and ventilation goods, including roof falls and the solar hot array panels shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be installed in accordance with the approved details. The details shall include any secondary outlets and details of the width of the guttering valleys

Condition : 5 - Detailed drawings of the relationship between the proposed metal cladding, brickwork and flashing, at a scale of not less than 1:20 and including elevation, plan and section details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development. The works thereafter shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans.
description: Erection of a ground floor rear and side extension and refurbishment of existing loft at the property
